quote: Every later LocalMemoryFileWatcher therefore reuses the dead transport and add() throws the old error, including watchers for newly created agents or a subsequent in-process lifecycle. The new replacement test explicitly pins this permanent failure.
note: The “Release the failed singleton after its worker exits” item asked for future watchers to get a fresh worker, which would still leave active subscriptions stranded after a crash. The author responded that restoring automatic observation still required a Gateway restart and deferred recovery.
